# Prince Edward Island budget

The Prince Edward Island budget is an annual Act of the Legislative Assembly of Prince Edward Island, giving statutory authority to the Government of Prince Edward Island for its revenue and expenditure plans. For the financial year 2024/25 the budget was approximately $3,232,384,400. The Appropriation Bill, is presented to the Legislative Assembly  by the minister of finance. The current finance minister is Jill Burridge, who was appointed to the role in April 2023.
Purpose
The Government of Prince Edward Island is ultimately accountable to the members of the House of Assembly and to the Prince Edward Island public for its use of public money and how its spending is allocated. The Government of Prince Edward Island allocates funding for areas which include schools, hospitals, policing, certain social security benefits, the economy, climate change and the environment, amongst others, from the Prince Edward Island budget. The Prince Edward Island budget is primarily funded via provincial taxes and the Canadian transfer payments.
